scope: Critical P5 China-beachhead and G7 repair review. This is a proposal only; it does not modify P4, the source ledger, the longlist, or selection.

decision_semantics.REINSTATE: All current hard gates pass and the China beachhead is countable now.
decision_semantics.CONDITIONAL_REINSTATE: Not eligible now. Reinstatement is permitted only after the listed primary evidence events occur and are origin-audited; it contributes zero to current China quotas.
decision_semantics.REJECT: Do not reinstate or flip the frozen China flag under the present product thesis.

strict_rules_applied: A sector target, present tender, standard publication, installed-base count, or license expiry is not by itself a product-specific 2028-2035 trigger.
A China beachhead counts only when a named buyer, procurement route, paid design-in, or evidence-backed license route is reachable without prohibited or structurally closed counterparties.
Product demand is not inferred from demand for the enclosing system.
Incumbent in-house capability and platform-spec absorption are treated as adverse evidence, not as market validation for a new merchant socket.
Every reinstatement requires two independent 2030 timing sources, including at least one primary or official product-specific 2028-2035 trigger.

summary.best_repair_candidate_status: CONDITIONAL_REINSTATE only; zero quota credit now
summary.feasibility_reason: The current 30-survivor pool has 16 frozen credible China beachheads. None of the six eliminated candidates passes both product-specific G1/G4 and strict G7 now, and neither E-14 nor F-06 has a named external China license or design-in route. This review therefore adds zero defensible China beachheads; a final 24 cannot reach 18 China beachheads by selection or by these repairs.
summary.required_portfolio_response: Do not manufacture quota compliance by relabeling license upside, present tenders, or sector plans. Either materially regenerate at least two non-L14, China-first products with new buyer evidence and qualifying 2028-2035 triggers, or report the final24 China quota as infeasible under the frozen corpus.

ranked_candidates.concept_short: Closed-loop inline-metrology plasma cleaning for PCB and advanced-packaging substrates
ranked_candidates.why_ranked_here: This is the only reviewed eliminated candidate with two independent exact-category China tenders, an international-open-bid route, a bounded experiment, and no fetched incumbent product showing the same inline treat-to-spec capability. It still fails the mission's strict timing and product-premium demand tests.

G1.rationale: Shennan Circuits and Guangzhou Guangxin Packaging Substrate independently tendered plasma cleaners, but neither tender requests inline surface-energy/residue metrology or pays the proposed premium. G1 becomes pass only after a named PCB or packaging buyer signs a paid beta or conditional order for the metrology-bearing product.

G4.rationale: Nordson MARCH, ACM Research, and domestic inline cleaners are named. Public materials do not show an exact closed-loop clone, but the feature is readily absorbable by capable incumbents, so paid differentiation must be proven.

G6.rationale: Both exact-category tenders permit international bidders, and no structural export-control bar was found for PCB or packaging plasma-cleaning tools. Restricted-party screening and current semiconductor-tool classification remain mandatory before sale.

G7.rationale: The exact tenders are dated 2025-2026; the official cleanliness project should publish around 2026; and the exact MIIT equipment catalogue is from 2019. None is a primary or official product-specific 2028-2035 trigger. Conditional passage requires an official 2028-2035 packaging cleanliness, traceability, qualification, or capacity instrument that directly forces this equipment or its inline metrology, plus an independent buyer roadmap extending procurement into 2030-2034.

source_1.title: Printed board assemblies - Part 7: Technical cleanliness of components and printed board assemblies
source_1.finding: Official SAMR/SAC project 20253175-Z-339, registered 2025-07-14 with a 12-month cycle and immediate implementation on publication. It is product-adjacent cleanliness evidence, but it does not require plasma cleaning, inline metrology, or any 2028-2035 action.

source_2.title: MIIT First-Set Major Technical Equipment Promotion Catalogue (2019 edition)
source_2.finding: Official catalogue item 13.4.9 explicitly names an inline plasma cleaner for IC packaging, at at least 500 wafers per hour and cleaning effect no more than 40 degrees. It proves exact category legitimacy but is a 2019 record, not a 2028-2035 trigger, and does not require closed-loop metrology.

supporting_current_procurement.finding: Guangzhou Guangxin's 2026 international-open retender proves a reachable present category, not an in-window future trigger or premium demand.

raw_score_changes_required_for_condition.condition: Paid metrology-bearing beta or conditional order from a named China PCB or packaging buyer.
Buyer data shows a valuable yield or traceability problem and accepts a premium position.
Blinded line-rate test shows a buyer-valued order-of-magnitude reduction in escaped surface-state failures or rework relative to open-loop cleaners.
Two independent 2030 timing sources, including an official product-specific 2028-2035 trigger, survive incumbent-roadmap review.

exact_evidence.claim: Wuxi Shennan Circuit exact-category plasma-cleaner international retender, bid deadline 2026-01-08.
Guangzhou Guangxin Packaging Substrate separate exact-category international retender, bid deadline 2026-03-19.
Nordson's audited filing confirms MARCH plasma-treatment systems are an established incumbent product line.
ACM Research already sells a cleaning tool into the same panel-level-packaging application, increasing fast-follower risk.

unresolved_blockers: No qualifying primary or official product-specific 2028-2035 trigger.
No buyer evidence for the closed-loop metrology feature or the claimed at least 30 percent premium.
No line-rate proof that the proxy predicts downstream bond or underfill outcomes better than incumbent process controls.
Nordson and ACM Research can absorb the feature before a 2030 launch.

ranked_candidates.concept_short: Standardized solid-state pulsed-power platform for e-beam, X-ray, and accelerator RF
ranked_candidates.why_ranked_here: Current system demand exists and a long-horizon medical-isotope policy exists, but neither establishes 2030 demand for an interoperable merchant modulator. Primary China evidence instead shows domestic-only tendering and successful in-house solid-state-modulator development.

G1.rationale: Varex, IBA, CGN, and cyclotron tenders validate accelerator systems, not a merchant standardized pulsed-power module or cross-OEM interface.

G4.rationale: ScandiNova, Jema, CPI, CGN Dasheng, and IHEP's in-house platform are direct alternatives. The modular/open-protocol distinction is non-cosmetic but unpurchased.

G6.rationale: The largest named industrial counterparty is adjacent to an Entity-Listed parent, while IHEP/CAS tenders require PRC-made products and primary records show domestic self-development. No independently reachable civilian China design-in is named.

G7.rationale: The 2021-2035 medical-isotope plan is a sector plan, not a modulator procurement trigger. Present accelerator orders and historical power-supply tenders do not show a merchant opening in 2030-2034.

source_1.title: Medical Isotope Medium- and Long-Term Development Plan (2021-2035)
source_1.finding: Official long-horizon sector policy; it does not specify merchant pulsed-power modules, an interoperable interface, or a procurement date for this product.

source_2.title: HEPS self-developed solid-state modulator passed acceptance
source_2.finding: CAS reports that the 315 kV, 380 A, 120 MW solid-state modulator was developed domestically and accepted in 2022. This is exact-category adverse evidence for incumbent absorption, not a 2028-2035 merchant trigger.

raw_changes.reason: System demand is not module demand.
Incumbents and CAS in-house development narrow the merchant socket.
No buyer benchmark establishes a 10x advantage over proprietary systems.
The China merchant route is not reachable on current evidence.

exact_evidence.claim: China Isotope and Radiation Corporation tendered three self-shielded cyclotrons in 2024; the tender does not specify an external modular pulsed-power platform.
IHEP's power-supply tender requires PRC-registered manufacturers, PRC-origin products, and no consortium bid, demonstrating structural access limits.

unresolved_blockers: No product-specific 2028-2035 trigger.
No paid OEM design-in for an interoperable module.
No cleared named China customer outside restricted or domestically closed channels.
A 500,000 dollar first experiment tests too broad a platform.

ranked_candidates.concept_short: Active-front-end rectifier retrofits for electrochemical plants
ranked_candidates.why_ranked_here: China continues to buy hydrogen rectifier equipment, but the fresh exact procurement specifies a mature rectifier module for a current demonstration, not an AFE retrofit or 2030 wave. Ingeteam already ships the AFE topology and Sungrow is vertically integrated.

G1.rationale: Current China electrolyzer and rectifier procurement is real, but no named buyer purchases the retrofit, performance contract, or claimed energy-saving product.

G4.rationale: Ingeteam already ships an IGBT AFE with under 3 percent harmonics; Sungrow and ABB occupy the exact power-supply layer. Retrofit packaging and M&V are services, not yet a defensible technical whitespace.

G6.rationale: Ordinary industrial rectification is not structurally export-blocked, subject to normal end-use and counterparty review.

G7.rationale: The US hydrogen deadline pulls projects before 2030, while China evidence shows present procurement and overcapacity, not an official 2028-2035 retrofit trigger.

source_1.title: Yulin Clean Energy Innovation Institute rectifier-transformer and rectifier-module procurement
source_1.finding: Primary 2026 government procurement for a 10 kV input, 7000 A/190 V output rectifier module with 100-day delivery. It proves current category buying but requires a mature product and does not procure an AFE retrofit or extend to 2028-2035.

source_2.title: New Energy System Construction 15th Five-Year Plan
source_2.finding: Official plan includes green-hydrogen bases through 2030, but it is a generic sector target and does not force AFE rectifier retrofits.

raw_changes.reason: No named retrofit buyer or bankable performance contract.
The exact AFE topology is shipping and vertically integrated.
No installed-cost and downtime comparison proves a buyer-valued order-of-magnitude edge.
Only current China system demand remains; the independent US hedge is weak.
Long payback and plant-specific integration constrain expansion.

exact_evidence.claim: Ingeteam already delivers an IGBT AFE rectifier with under 3 percent harmonic distortion.
China's electrolyzer manufacturing capacity materially exceeds deployment, weakening a post-2030 scarcity thesis.

unresolved_blockers: No official 2028-2035 retrofit program.
No named plant buyer for the retrofit product.
No field data showing an acceptable payback after downtime and installed retrofit cost.
Exact-topology incumbent and vertically integrated China leader already present.

ranked_candidates.why_ranked_here: US and China demand are both real, but the exact function is already in NVIDIA's ecosystem specification and is being implemented by major power-platform vendors. More timing evidence strengthens the pre-2030 absorption case rather than repairing it.

G1.rationale: NVIDIA and China 800 VDC evidence establish the exact system need in both markets.

G4.rationale: The platform specification and eight named ecosystem partners are the direct substitute; a standalone film-capacitor buffer has no durable merchant whitespace.

G6.rationale: The module is plausibly separable by local components, subject to current EAR review.

G7.rationale: The exact buffer function is being specified and built in 2025-2026, before the company's 2030 launch. The product should remain folded into C-01.

source_1.title: Building the 800 VDC Ecosystem for Efficient, Scalable AI Factories
source_1.finding: NVIDIA explicitly specifies rack-adjacent capacitors and supercapacitors for power spikes and names eight implementation partners. This is product-specific but shows 2025 absorption.

source_2.title: 2026: The First Year of 800 VDC Commercialization
source_2.finding: China-side 800 VDC adoption is underway now, with a 2026-2029 ramp. It does not preserve a new standalone entrant's 2030 window.

raw_changes.reason: Platform specification and named majors absorb the function.
No 10x buyer-valued advantage over integrated capacitor, BBU, and power-shelf solutions is demonstrated.

exact_evidence.claim: Vicor has shipped adjacent dense 800 V conversion hardware since 2019.

unresolved_blockers: Pre-agreed commoditization kill trigger has already fired.
No standalone attach-rate evidence after platform integration.
No durable differentiation beyond a module option for C-01.

ranked_candidates.concept_short: Thermal and prognostic subsystems for MCS and China battery-swap connectors
ranked_candidates.why_ranked_here: China station procurement is open, but the exact connector and thermal layer is already supplied by Recodeal or vertically integrated by CATL, and Phoenix Contact is shipping the US cooled interface. The merchant slice is small and the window opened before 2030.

G1.rationale: End-market infrastructure demand is not a buyer request for the proposed merchant thermal subsystem or prognostics layer.

G4.rationale: Phoenix Contact and Recodeal are exact competitors; prognostics are non-cosmetic but readily absorbable.

G6.rationale: China tenders require domestic manufacturing history and a local partner; the route is difficult but not categorically prohibited.

G7.rationale: Standards, deployments, and incumbents converge in 2026-2028, leaving no unoccupied 2030 launch window.

source_1.title: IEC TS 63379 Megawatt Charging System
source_1.finding: Official category standard published in February 2026. It accelerates incumbent design-in before 2030 and does not require the proposed independent thermal subsystem.

source_2.title: Recodeal enters NIO supply chain
source_2.finding: Recodeal is already NIO's primary swap-connector supplier. This is exact-category incumbent capture, not a future opening.

raw_changes.reason: Both system markets exist, but neither offers a demonstrated merchant socket.

exact_evidence.claim: Sinochem's China station tender is open but manufacturer-only and requires a delivery track record.
Phoenix Contact already integrates water-glycol cooling, sensing, and leak detection into a megawatt-class connector.

unresolved_blockers: No paid thermal-subsystem or prognostics design-in.
Direct incumbents already qualified on both legs.
Merchant TAM remains sub-scale.
The 450,000 dollar experiment is above the preferred range.

ranked_candidates.concept_short: Merchant precision high-voltage DC modules for e-beam, implant, and X-ray OEMs
ranked_candidates.why_ranked_here: The P4 competitor map refuted the thin-market premise, the China institutional route is domestic-only, and no merchant module order or 2028-2035 trigger exists.

G1.rationale: US OEM-system orders do not identify a precision-HV module design-in, and no China merchant buyer is evidenced.

G4.rationale: Spellman and Advanced Energy are direct incumbents; arc recovery and telemetry are non-cosmetic but unbenchmarked.

G6.rationale: The China big-science route is domestic-product-only, while the named CGN route requires ownership and end-use screening. No alternative reachable China customer is named.

G7.rationale: The medical-isotope plan is sector-level, and current cargo, implant, and accelerator demand supplies no primary product-specific 2028-2035 merchant-HV trigger.

source_1.title: Medical Isotope Medium- and Long-Term Development Plan (2021-2035)
source_1.finding: Long-horizon official sector demand, but no precision-HV module procurement or merchant-sourcing rule.

source_2.title: IHEP klystron focusing power supply tender
source_2.finding: Exact power-supply procurement but historical, low-voltage focusing supplies rather than F-20's 50-300 kV product, and restricted to PRC-made products.

score_changes.note: No mechanical score reduction is needed: competition whitespace, dual-market leverage, and window are already raw 1. The hard-gate failures remain dispositive.

exact_evidence.claim: Spellman is a large global precision-HV incumbent with multiple design, production, and repair locations.
Advanced Energy also sells directly overlapping merchant high-voltage products into semiconductor and industrial uses.

unresolved_blockers: No China merchant customer.
No official product-specific 2028-2035 trigger.
Crowded incumbent field.
No paid 2028 OEM evaluation or arc-recovery benchmark.

ranked_candidates.concept_short: Multi-terminal DC protection relay and vendor-neutral HIL qualification
ranked_candidates.repair_scope_note: Reject only the proposed China-beachhead flip. The underlying US idea remains a P5 HOLD subject to paid-study and model-access evidence.
ranked_candidates.why_ranked_here: NR Electric and XJ offer integrated multi-terminal protection, RTDS/HIL, DC breakers, measurement, and complete HVDC platforms. No primary evidence shows either would license, buy, or expose proprietary models to an external neutral platform.

G1.rationale: US project spending validates protection work. China procurement validates incumbent integrated systems, not an external HIL service or relay.

G4.rationale: Neutrality is non-cosmetic in principle, but NR/XJ already perform RTDS tests and own the protection stack; the China whitespace is not demonstrated.

G6.rationale: A low-tier software or study export may be legally classifiable, but no reachable license counterparty or model-sharing route is evidenced. Legal possibility is not a beachhead.

G7.rationale: US project dates can support the underlying launch thesis, but no China product-specific 2028-2035 procurement or external qualification trigger exists.

source_1.title: NR Electric VSC-HVDC Solution
source_1.finding: NR states that it owns certified RTDS and RT-LAB facilities, HVDC protection, DC breakers, and DC measurement equipment. This is present integrated incumbent capability, not a 2028-2035 external-purchase trigger.

source_2.title: XJ Electric HVDC control and protection systems
source_2.finding: XJ markets complete multi-terminal and VSC-HVDC control/protection and simulation systems with more than 40 percent market share. No external neutral-service socket is named.

exact_evidence.claim: NR supplied the Zhangbei four-terminal VSC-HVDC project's control/protection, converters, breakers, and DC measurement equipment.
NR built the project RTDS model and completed 120 functional and 70 dynamic tests for an export project, showing in-house HIL capability.

unresolved_blockers: No China utility, EPC, or OEM paid study.
No model-sharing or HIL memorandum.
No external license or design-in route with NR, XJ, or State Grid.
China incumbents own the complete protection and test stack.

ranked_candidates.concept_short: Wideband DC current and voltage sensing for HVDC
ranked_candidates.repair_scope_note: Reject the proposed China-beachhead flip. The completed P5 red team separately recommends killing the current US product because product-specific demand and timing are absent.
ranked_candidates.why_ranked_here: Primary China company evidence is especially adverse: XJ developed the complete 1100 kV all-fiber DC current transformer and NR supplies DC measurement equipment inside its own HVDC stack. There is no external sensor license, design-in, or merchant socket.

G1.rationale: Neither US projects nor China HVDC awards specify the proposed external wideband sensor. No second product buyer is named.

G4.rationale: LEM, XJ, NR, ABB, and Hitachi are direct alternatives. Combined bandwidth and accuracy are unbenchmarked, and the merchant interface is absent.

G6.rationale: US technical work is not structurally blocked, but no reachable China licensing route is evidenced; legal exportability cannot substitute for buyer access.

G7.rationale: The US compliance citation is a different measurement job, and China evidence shows current vertically bundled procurement rather than an external 2028-2035 sensor trigger.

source_1.title: XJ Electric 1100 kV all-fiber DC current transformer development
source_1.finding: XJ reports complete domestic research, test, and engineering deployment of the world's highest-voltage all-fiber DC current transformer. This is exact-category incumbent absorption, not external demand.

source_2.title: NR Electric Zhangbei four-terminal HVDC supply
source_2.finding: NR supplied DC measurement equipment as part of an integrated multi-terminal HVDC package. No external wideband sensor purchase or future license trigger is named.

exact_evidence.claim: XJ won approximately RMB 1.275 billion of State Grid DC products in 2026, including converter valves and control/protection, showing domestic integrated procurement.
LEM operates an established China-facing sensor business; no evidence links the proposed new wideband product to a named HVDC design-in.

unresolved_blockers: No named China licensee or design-in.
XJ and NR already own the exact measurement layer.
No buyer requirement for the proposed bandwidth and accuracy combination.
No product-specific 2028-2035 trigger on either market leg.

better_non_l14_candidate_check.conclusion: No additional eliminated non-L14 candidate clearly dominates F-16 or repairs the quota.

p4_prescreened_not_advanced.reason: China-capable on the frozen record, but G4 and G7 fail against multiple funded MV-SST entrants and pre-2030 capture.
No merchant AMB-electronics buyer on either leg; China localization and Entity-Listed anchor risks worsen access.
No repower-kit or export-certification buyer; current programs buy new equipment and the regulatory thesis weakened.
No buyer, tender, or forward-dated trigger for laser-ultrasonic weld inspection in either market.
Guoli already supplies the exact China variable-capacitor buyer set, eliminating the claimed second-source whitespace.
